text: Program Description Program Introduction The major is to cultivate the interdisciplinary talents who have broad theoretical basis, professional knowledge and practical ability in electric engineering and automation, can engage in equipment manufacturing, system operation, automatic control, information processing, experimental analysis，technological development and computer application. The graduates master the basic theory and design of electric control system, can carry out the relevant engineering practice training, have the abilities of designing common automatic control system, motor speed control system and power supply system of factories. Main courses Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, Analog Electronic Technology, Digital electronic technology, Electric Machinery, Automatic Control Theory, The Principle and Application of Microcomputer, Power Electronic Technology, Electrical Control Technology, Plant Power Supply, Motion Control System, Power System Analysis and so on. Main practice courses Practice on Computer Application Basic Training, Electronic Technology Practice, Course Design of Analog Electronics, Course Design of Digital Electronic, Power Electronic System Design, Motor Speed Control System Design, Power Supply System Design, the Design of Electrical Control Technology, PLC System Training, Comprehensive Training in Electrical Engineering, Production Practice and so on. Employment direction The graduates can pursue the master degree of related majors. In electric control, electric drive and power supply fields, they also engage in research and teaching in scientific research institutes and universities, engaged in design, operation, maintenance of electric equipment and management in enterprises.
